summary_en: FY2027 year-end dividend increased by 28 yen per share to 189 yen (pre-split basis) from the previous forecast of 161 yen, reflecting upward revision of earnings guidance driven by stronger semiconductor and aerospace businesses.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Financial Forecasts and Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Sinfonia Technology announced an increase in its FY2027 (ending March 31, 2027) year-end dividend forecast. The company raised the year-end dividend from the previously forecast 161 yen per share to 189 yen per share on a pre-split basis, representing an increase of 28 yen. This revision was driven by an upward revision to full-year earnings guidance, with consolidated operating profit forecast raised from 21.0 billion yen to 25.0 billion yen, primarily due to improved sales and profitability in the semiconductor-related business, aerospace-related equipment, and engineering & services segments.

The company stated that it determines dividend distributions based on continuous and stable implementation principles, while taking into account shareholder returns, corporate financial strengthening, and capital expenditures and R&D investments required for future business expansion. No interim dividend (second quarter) is planned. The company is scheduled to implement a 1-for-3 stock split effective January 1, 2027; the dividend figures disclosed are presented on a pre-split basis to facilitate comparison with prior forecasts.
